ImageDrop.Hint.zh: 在目标位置松手插入图片，Esc 或 {0} 取消。
ImageDrop.Hint.en: Release at the desired position to insert the image. Esc or {0} cancels.

ImageDrop.Unsupported.zh: 只支持图像数据或 PNG、JPEG、BMP、WebP 图像文件，不支持网址或网页链接。
ImageDrop.Unsupported.en: Only image data or PNG, JPEG, BMP and WebP image files are supported, not URLs or web links.

ImageDrop.Failed.zh:
导入失败：{0}
可以重新拖入图片。
ImageDrop.Failed.en:
Import failed: {0}
You can drag the images in again.

ImageDrop.TargetChanged.zh: 目标画布已关闭或更换，请重新拖入图片。
ImageDrop.TargetChanged.en: The target canvas was closed or replaced. Drag the images in again.
